text:
Stradal Group has acquired Fennimore Optics, the family-run lens maker based in Port Halcyon, company officials said Tuesday. The deal closed Monday for an undisclosed sum and includes Fennimore’s factory on Dockside Avenue, where 84 employees make specialty glass components for marine and medical devices.

Harbour economic development director Leona Vescari said the acquisition should preserve jobs and expand production. “Stradal has told us it plans to keep the Port Halcyon plant open and invest in new equipment within the next six months,” Vescari said.

Fennimore Optics, founded in 1978, will continue operating under its existing name during a transition period, Stradal said. The privately held conglomerate is based in Northmere and has holdings in precision tools and industrial materials.
